releases.notes:
Control render distance, simulation distance, and master volume on the fly — no menus, no pause. Designed for Stream Deck users but works great with any keyboard or macro device.

Keybinds

Keybind | Action -- | -- Ctrl + . | Render distance +1 Ctrl + , | Render distance -1 Ctrl + ] | Simulation distance +1 Ctrl + [ | Simulation distance -1 Ctrl + = | Master volume +5% Ctrl + - | Master volume -5% # DeckTweaks v1.0.0 Control render distance, simulation distance, and master volume on the fly — no menus, no pause. Designed for Stream Deck users but works great with any keyboard or macro device. --- ## Keybinds | Keybind | Action | |---|---| | `Ctrl` + `.` | Render distance +1 | | `Ctrl` + `,` | Render distance -1 | | `Ctrl` + `]` | Simulation distance +1 | | `Ctrl` + `[` | Simulation distance -1 | | `Ctrl` + `=` | Master volume +5% | | `Ctrl` + `-` | Master volume -5% | All changes show as a subtle toast notification in the bottom-right corner of your screen. --- ## Requirements - Minecraft 1.21.11 - Fabric Loader ≥ 0.18.4 - [[Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) --- ## Installation Download `decktweaks-1.0.0.jar` and drop it into your `mods/` folder alongside Fabric API. | OS | Mods folder | |---|---| | **Windows** | `%AppData%\.minecraft\mods` | | **macOS** | `~/Library/Application Support/minecraft/mods` | | **Linux** | `~/.minecraft/mods` |
